members.name: Karim Bouaoui
members.quote:
What I love about working at Cible is the diversity of the team. It's what makes it strong and rich. It's this diversity that always pushes us forward, toward achievement and success.

"He who is different from me does not impoverish me – he enriches me."

members.name: Raquel Ramos Salado
members.quote:
What I love most about working at Cible is the ability to bring light into the darkness that can sometimes surround a job search. It's a privilege to help others reach their goals through self-confidence and self-discovery.

"If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude."

members.name: Sibi Lawson
members.quote:
We live in an era where many people are searching for meaning. Some also settle for merely existing… For my part, I hold the conviction that every being on earth should know why they are here and do what they are here to do, in order to find meaning in existence.

I also believe that the job one holds should be a means of fulfilling one's life mission, while remaining realistic of course. A job aligned with the person's deep values, one that meets their aspirations and allows them to unlock their full potential.

This is my mission at Cible: to accompany our participants on this journey toward self-knowledge, identifying their unique abilities and achievements, with the conviction that this is certainly an answer to needs within their environment.

"The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why."

members.name: Inès Laurent
members.quote:
The common thread throughout my career has been human connection and helping others. Working for Cible is an opportunity for me to best support participants, giving them the tools and support they need to shine in their job search.

Every meeting is, for me, an opportunity to listen, understand, and encourage. I deeply believe that everyone has unique potential, and that the role of support is to help reveal it.

"Alone we go faster; together we go further."

members.name: Mariane La France
members.quote:
Specializing in marginalized communities, such as queer and/or neurodivergent individuals, I am committed to offering a safe space where participants can build confidence in their unique skills. Through an intersectional approach, I prioritize active listening in order to show empathy toward everyone who comes through my office.

"For every problem, there are several solutions."

members.name: Christian Dame
members.quote:
Career counselling is about giving yourself the chance to revisit your ideas about yourself, your limits and your potential, real or imagined, and to make a choice that truly reflects and motivates you. My role as a career counsellor is to diligently support you through this process of self-realization. I ask questions, offer suggestions, inform, and listen attentively without judgment. It is through this personal and professional exchange that a synergy can develop between your aspirations, your career plans, and the realities of the job market.

"To become aware is to turn the veil that covers the light into a mirror."
